full-name: Cyril Hammond Elgie, later Elgee
first-name: Cyril Hammond
last-name: Elgie, later Elgee
title: Cyril Hammond Elgie, later Elgee
dates: (18 October 1871-17 August 1917)
---

eldest son of the Rev. W. F. Elgie

He left Lancing 1889, and resigned his commission in 1904. He was a colonial administrator for twenty years.  [Lancing Register;  tablet in Otterbourne Church]
